title: Zen — Restaurant Brand Identity Design Egypt | admepro
desc: admepro created the Zen brand identity and campaign — balancing minimal aesthetics with impactful creative direction to reflect calm, premium positioning.
content: P: Zen offers premium body serum candles infused with plant-based ingredients. Made in Egypt with 100% organic materials, these spa-quality candles provide a gentle warm sensation, perfect for a luxurious self-care experience.
LI: Tags Cosmetics , Egypt , Identity , Packaging
H2: Where creativity meets purpose the art behind our design creates timeless brand stories.
P: The Zen logo embodies artistic innovation through its unique vertical composition, where each letter flows seamlessly into the next, creating a harmonious visual rhythm.
P: The distinctive star element, elegantly integrated into the letter ‘E’, serves dual purposes – enhancing the primary logotype while standing alone as a powerful secondary mark.
H2: Unveiling Our Captivating Color Palette.
P: The primary palette features Avorio Chiaro, Rosso Beige, and Bianco Perla, creating a harmonious blend of warm, earthy tones that evoke feelings of luxury and natural wellness.
P: While Verde Reseda and Grigio Segnale serve as sophisticated secondary hues, adding depth and versatility to the brand’s visual language while maintaining its serene aesthetic.
H2: Building the foundation creating a strategic identity for Zen.

P: Our journey with Zen began with developing a comprehensive brand strategy that positioned them in the luxury wellness market. We crafted their brand identity to reflect the pure, organic nature of their products while maintaining an air of sophistication and tranquility.

P: The project extended to creating distinctive packaging designs that showcase the product’s premium quality. Each element was carefully curated to communicate Zen’s commitment to organic ingredients, resulting in a cohesive brand presence.
H2: Bringing the Vision to life, Where creativity and purpose meet to shape brand excellence
P: We’re a team of creatives who are excited about unique ideas and create amazing identity .
